import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path("apps/runtime-dashboard/public/atlas/trust-claim-posture.v1.json")

assert record["canonical_equals_scratch_bytes"] and record["generated_reference_equals_head_bytes"] and a==b
